paper.title_en: Off-shell one-loop counterterms of Palatini gravity with an independent background connection
paper.abstract_en: We compute the one-loop divergences of pure gravity in the first-order (Palatini) formulation, using the background field method in Goldberg variables, with a background connection independent of the background metric. Background Ward-Takahashi identities are verified at one loop. The divergences of the two-point functions, obtained in arbitrary dimension and gauge, require, besides the curvature-squared terms, invariants built from the nonmetricity of the background connection; in particular, the Gauss-Bonnet combination, which is not topological for a nonmetric connection, does not suffice. Three- and four-point functions in the Feynman-de Donder gauge complete the counterterm Lagrangian up to fourth order in the nonmetricity and provide parameter-free tests of it. All the counterterms vanish on shell, as in the metric formulation, and off shell they can be removed by field redefinitions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Palatini（一阶）表述下用Goldberg变量和独立背景联络计算单圈散度，直接属于Palatini引力与度规-仿射引力范畴；显式验证背景Ward-Takahashi恒等式、给出任意维与任意规范下的两点函数发散，并用三、四点函数补全至非度规性四阶，方法细节与理论深度都较充分，值得点开阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带独立背景联络的Palatini引力的离壳单圈抵消项
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在Goldberg变量中采用背景场方法，计算了第一阶（Palatini）表述下纯引力的单圈发散，其中背景联络独立于背景度规。背景Ward-Takahashi恒等式在一圈阶得到验证。在任意维度和任意规范下得到的二点函数发散，除曲率平方项外，还需要由背景联络的非度规性构造的不变量；特别地，对于非度规联络，Gauss-Bonnet组合不再是拓扑项，因此不足以满足要求。Feynman-de Donder规范下的三点和四点函数将抵消项拉格朗日量补全至非度规性的四阶，并为其提供了无参数检验。所有抵消项在壳时为零，与度规表述中的情形一样；离壳时它们可以通过场重定义消除。
